FishingDudeText:
I am the FISHING
DUDE, the elder of the FISHING BROS.

Have you met the
FISHING GURU at LAKE OF RAGE?

He dreams about
seeing the world's greatest MAGIKARP.

If you don't mind,
could you show him

any MAGIKARP you
catch?

Who knows, you may
catch the MAGIKARP of his dreams.
FishingDudesHousePhotoText:
It's a photo of
people fishing…

They're having a
great time…
